Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000232": As of 2025-02-27, Yuki Tanaka has the Cinder pager this cycle, taking over from Diego.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Diego, Cinder)
- memory_id "1000114": Cinder owns the indexer.  (about: Cinder, indexer)
- memory_id "1000108": Team Cinder owns the product catalog.  (about: Cinder, product catalog)
- memory_id "1000021": Yuki Tanaka and Diego are on Cinder.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Diego, Cinder)
- memory_id "1000321": The catalog service calls the image resizer for thumbnails, so the image resizer is a hard dependency of the catalog service.  (about: image resizer, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000172" [decision]: After INC-2025-004, the notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds because a stuck offset went unnoticed for 40 minutes.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000272": As of 2025-03-20, the image resizer is owned by the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, image resizer)
- memory_id "1000154": The search indexer relies on the catalog service for product documents, so if the catalog service is down, the search indexer is down.  (about: indexer, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000228": On 2025-02-21, the Boreal team noticed the ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000285": As of 2025-03-26, the Dune team observed that after the cache change, the notification service's memory use grew steadily for a week.  (about: Dune team, notification service)
- memory_id "1000269" [constraint]: The catalog service can be released on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000167": The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004, broker)
- memory_id "1000001": The Atlas team in 2025 consists of Priya Raman and Tomasz.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
- memory_id "1000163": During incident INC-2025-004, the notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000220" [decision]: As of 2025-02-21, the notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000160" [constraint]: The ledger service must stay on Postgres 14 until the partitioning work finishes.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000090": As of 2025-01-10, the Ember team is a one-person team consisting of Oskar.  (about: Ember team, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000240": As of 2025-03-03, the pager for the webhook dispatcher rings the Ember team.  (about: webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000301" [constraint]: Changes to the billing API need a rollback plan attached to the pull request.  (about: billing API)
- memory_id "1000309": As of 2025-04-03, Tomasz is the primary on-call for the Atlas team, not Priya Raman.  (about: Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz)
Existing entity names: Yuki Tanaka, Diego, Cinder, indexer, product catalog, image resizer, catalog service, notifier, INC-2025-004, Ember team, Boreal team, ledger service, Dune team, notification service, broker, Atlas team, Priya Raman, Tomasz, Oskar, webhook dispatcher, billing API
